compiled_prompt: Plasticine stop-motion. Tall lanky clay lighthouse keeper in oversized yellow raincoat and short round clay terrier in green hat and red scarf stand in the open lighthouse doorway. Grey-green sea and white waves behind them, overcast coastal light, wind moving the raincoat and scarf. The keeper steps out, holds his hat, and says in a slow deadpan English voice: "I am only checking. We are not arguing with the ocean." The terrier runs ahead, spins, points at a big wave and says in a quick high voice: "That one just waved at us!" The keeper looks at the wave, then at the terrier: "That is what waves do." Slightly stepped stop-motion, slow camera pull-back then settle. Audio: clear turn-taking voices, wind, distant waves, light comic woodwind.
